title: Cozy Cottage Kitchens
subtitle: An Adult Coloring Book of Warm Kitchens, Fresh Bakes and Slow Mornings for Relaxation
style_prompt: Storybook cottagecore illustration with gentle hand-drawn charm, rounded forms, wooden textures shown only with outlines, plants and patterned fabrics, warm and uncluttered.
cover_scene: A sunlit cottage kitchen counter with a fresh pie cooling by an open window, herbs in pots, a teapot and a sleeping cat on a chair.
back_blurb:
Slow down and step into the coziest kitchens you've ever imagined.
Each design is printed on its own page with a blank back, so markers won't bleed through.
